name: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention (arXiv:2506.13585)
notes: Primary source for MiniMax-M1's hybrid attention pattern: 456B total / 45.9B activated, combining MoE (32 local experts, 2 per token) with a lightning-attention mechanism interleaved with full attention. The config.json layer_types array confirms the exact split - 70 linear_attention layers and 10 full_attention layers out of 80.
